name: arrivalos
description: Modular decision-support platform for migrants in Germany

scripts.build: npm run build -w @arrivalos/core && npm run build -w @arrivalos/profile && npm run build -w @arrivalos/shared-services && npm run build -w @arrivalos/modules && npm run build -w @arrivalos/ux && npm run build -w @arrivalos/api && npm run build -w @arrivalos/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @arrivalos/profile && npm run test -w @arrivalos/shared-services && npm run test -w @arrivalos/modules && npm run test -w @arrivalos/ux && npm run test -w @arrivalos/api
